template.name: NodeNomination
BConsensusChecker
NodeBallot
NodeCheckNomination
template.declaration:
/* On `CheckNominationStarted`,
receiving `slotDone` message, check two guards: 1. if all nodes nominated `valueID` -> goes to `CheckNominationSuccess` 2. if all nodes somehow nominated `valueID`, but they are not same value -> goes back to StartCheckNomination */

query.comment: Success Possibility (Reachability) Purpose: Does there exist an execution path where all slots can be successfully completed?
Failure Prevention (Safety Property) Purpose: Does no slot failure occur in any execution?
Considering faulty nodes Timeout Prevention (Safety Property with Faulty Nodes) Purpose: Do timeout-induced slot failures not occur?
Not considering faulty nodes Integrated Failure Prevention (Combined Safety) Purpose: Are all forms of slot failures prevented?

query.formula: A[] forall (i : s_id) (NodeSlot(i).SlotSuccess imply forall (j : v_id) not NodeCheckNomination(j).StartCheckNomination)
query.comment: Nomination Completeness (Completeness) Purpose: If a slot succeeds, has nomination necessarily been completed?
Ballot Consistency (Ballot Consistency) Purpose: Are previous prepare ballots properly managed?

query.formula: A[] forall (i : n_id) ballotStates[i].c.counter != 0 imply (ballotStates[i].c.value == ballotStates[i].h.value && ballotStates[i].c.counter <= ballotStates[i].h.counter) && (ballotStates[i].h.value == ballotStates[i].b.value && ballotStates[i].h.counter <= ballotStates[i].b.counter)

query.comment: Deadlock Prevention (Liveness Property) Purpose: Does the system not fall into deadlock?
